matchData.information:
Best of 3 (LAN)

* Swiss round 3 (teams with a 2-0 record). Winner advances to playoffs.
matchData.veto:
1. The MongolZ removed Train
2. paiN removed Ancient
3. The MongolZ picked Inferno
4. paiN picked Dust2
5. paiN removed Anubis
6. The MongolZ removed Nuke
7. Mirage was left over

highlights.description: M1R12 | nqz - 1vs2 MP9 clutch (CT - post-plant situation)
M1R25 | nqz - 4 AK kills (2 HS) on the bombsite B offensive (2vs4 situation)
M1R28 | Senzu - 1vs2 clutch (T - post-plant situation) to set The MongolZ on map point
M3R11 | Techno - 4 quick kills (2 M4A1-S, 2 USP-S HS) on the bombsite B defense (including 1vs3 clutch) to turn an initial 2vs4 situation
M2R26 | biguzera - 4 M4A1-S kills (3 HS) on the bombsite A defense
M2R27 | biguzera - 4 AK kills (3 HS) on the defense
M3R21 | Senzu - 4 M4A4 kills on the bombsite B defense to secure the match victory for The MongolZ
